name: Contact Flow 3.0.1 (build 9)
body:
**Version 3.0.1 (build 9)**

### Swipe
- Swipe actions are much harder to trigger by accident: a deliberate drag is needed, quick flicks no longer fire, and flicking back cancels.
- The icon fills in with a small vibration when the action is armed; let go early and the row springs back.
- Mostly vertical scrolling never starts a swipe, and swipes that begin at the screen edge are left to the system back gesture.
- Same behaviour on the Calls tab.

### Fixes
- Switching tabs no longer loses your place: scroll position, search and selection stay as you left them. Before, the search box came back empty while the list was still filtered.
- Calls refreshes quietly when you come back to the tab or the app.
- Only the tab you are looking at handles the back gesture.
- The contact editor asks before discarding unsaved changes.
- The fade behind the selection bar no longer blocks scrolling.
- Tags: the New tag button no longer covers the last tag's menu, and colour choices are easier to tap.

Two editions: `lite` (no call-log permission) and `full`.

name: Contact Flow 3.0.0 (build 8)
body:
**Version 3.0.0 (build 8)**

### New
- Bottom bar: Contacts, Tags, Files (and Calls in the full edition).
- Search by any part of a number, in any format, plus pattern search (`*36`, `02*`, `?`, commas, `#tags`).
- Tags on numbers, a tag filter, and tags in exports.
- Calls tab for numbers you called but never saved (full edition only). The call log is read on the phone and never leaves it.
- Swipe a contact to call or message; long press then drag to select several. Swipe actions can be turned off in Settings.
- Import review groups new and existing contacts, and each row can show the original line from your file.
- Optional "Use system colours" on Android 12 and up.
- Loading placeholders instead of spinners; clearer empty states.
- Arabic plurals and right-to-left fixes throughout.

### Faster and safer
- Much faster import of big text and vCard files (a million-line text file in about five seconds).
- Large files are read in the background; files over 64 MB are refused with a clear message.
- The contact list is no longer re-indexed on return to the app when nothing changed.
- Dedupe preview with undo; "Move my data".
- Contacts and tags are left out of Google backup.

### Fixes
- Same-named groups in different accounts no longer get mixed up.
- The same number in two countries no longer matches as one.
- Larger tap targets, and no overflow at large text sizes.

Two editions: `lite` (no call-log permission) and `full`.

name: Release v2.5.0
body:
## What's new in 2.5.0

**Number checks:** New filters in the Phone workspace find contacts with no country code, odd number formats, or numbers shared across multiple contacts. Live counts and helpful hints make it easier to spot issues. Odd-number checks validate the format only; they do not verify whether a number is real.

**Complete translations:** Chinese, Spanish and French are now fully translated across the Phone workspace, batch editor, history and permission screens.

**Clearer imports:** The import review now shows how many rows were skipped because they had no phone number or email address.

**Better accessibility:** Buttons are announced correctly by screen readers, icon-only buttons have labels, animations respect reduced-motion settings, and loading displays “Reading your contacts…” instead of a bare spinner.

**Improved readability:** Increased text contrast in light and dark themes, with automated tests to help keep text readable.

**Under the hood:** Added tests for number-check accuracy and performance on large contact lists, translation completeness, and colour contrast.

name: Release v2.3.0
body:
## What's new in 2.3.0

- Blank import template: Import → Blank template saves an Excel or CSV
  file with exactly the columns the app reads, in your language. The
  Excel version keeps "+" and leading zeros in phone numbers and has an
  Instructions sheet with examples. Share it, have people fill it in,
  then import it.
- Clearer import errors: a damaged file, an old .xls, a PDF or image,
  an empty file, a sheet without a phone or email column, or the
  untouched template now explain what is wrong instead of a generic
  "nothing found", with template buttons where they help.
- Renamed files still work: a CSV saved as .xlsx, or the reverse, is
  detected by content.
- Fixed: Arabic exports lost the company column when imported back.
- Fixed: imports dropped job title, starred and groups.
- Fixed: damaged spreadsheets could hang the importer or misread text.
- Fixed: names starting with -, + or @ gained a stray apostrophe after
  a CSV round trip.

name: Release v2.2.0
body:
## Aliases for names

Contacts can now have **several aliases**: nicknames, kunyas such as "Abu Omar", or other spellings of the same name. Search for any of them and you'll find the person.

- **Add as many as you need.** Each alias is a chip in the editor. Tap one to make it the main alias, or tap × to remove it.
- **Search by any alias.** Each person shows up once, labelled "aka …" so you can see which alias matched.
- **Shown on the contact.** Aliases appear under the name on the detail screen.
- **Saved where Android expects them.** Aliases go into the phone's own Nickname field, so other contacts apps and account sync see them too. Nicknames already on your phone show up as aliases.
- **In your files.**
  - vCard `NICKNAME`
  - An **Alias** column in CSV, Excel and Numbers. Headers such as *Nickname*, *AKA*, *اسم بديل*, *别名*, *Apodo* and *Surnom* are recognised.
  - `aliases` in JSON
  - A switch to leave aliases out of an export
- **Merging duplicates** keeps the other contacts' names as aliases, so nothing is lost.
- **Spreadsheet sync** handles aliases per policy: *Fill empty* fills them, *Overwrite* replaces them, *Add numbers* adds to them. Contact matching also checks aliases.
- **Batch edit** has four new operations: add alias, keep current name as alias, swap name and first alias, clear aliases.
- **`{alias}` token** for personalised messages and rename patterns. If a contact has no alias, it uses the first name.

## Improvements and fixes

- Editing a phone contact now keeps name prefixes, phonetic names, organisation details and per-number info that were already stored.
- Long labels no longer overflow on screens with large text sizes.
- Launcher icons fixed for the release build.

## Privacy

Same as always: **contacts permission only**. No internet, no analytics, no ads, no proprietary libraries.

## Downloads

| File | For | versionCode |
|---|---|---|
| `ContactFlow-2.2.0-arm64-v8a.apk` | Most phones from 2017 on | 2005 |
| `ContactFlow-2.2.0-armeabi-v7a.apk` | Older 32-bit phones | 1005 |
| `ContactFlow-2.2.0-x86_64.apk` | Emulators, x86 devices | 4005 |
| `ContactFlow-2.2.0-universal.apk` | Any device | 5 |

Not sure which one to pick? Choose **arm64-v8a**, or **universal** if that one doesn't install.

### SHA-256 checksums

name: Release v2.1.0
body:
Turn Contact Flow from an import/export tool into a manager for the
contacts on the phone. Every phone write goes through a reviewed,
backed-up and undoable change pipeline.

Phone workspace
- New Phone tab next to Files, sharing one Contact model
- Search, sort, filters (account, starred, group, no number, no name)
  and an A–Z scroller; fixed-height rows stay smooth with 5,000+ contacts
- Detail screen with account, quick actions, star, share vCard, edit
  and delete
- Create/edit form: name, labelled numbers, emails, company, job title,
  note, groups, starred, target account
- Bulk star, group, delete, share, copy numbers and the batch table
- Permission explanation screen, denied and blocked states, and a
  web-only demo phone book (FakeSource)
- Refreshes on resume and when the contacts database changes

Change pipeline
- Pure planners produce ChangeSets of Create/Update/Delete/Merge with
  field diffs
- Shared Review screen: grouped rows, per-row checkboxes, counts, diffs,
  synced-account delete warning
- Executor saves each affected contact as a vCard snapshot in the
  Journal before writing, applies in batches of 25 with progress and
  Cancel, and records each failure without stopping the run
- Undo is the inverse ChangeSet sent through the same pipeline
- "N contacts updated · Undo" SnackBar after every apply
- Settings → History: undo, share backup as .vcf, delete, storage used;
  keeps 30 entries or 30 days

Sync from a spreadsheet
- Optional contact_id column in CSV/XLSX export; read back on import
- "Update contacts on this phone" from the import review
- Matcher: contact_id → normalized number → exact normalized name;
  ambiguous rows become conflicts and shared numbers are never matched
- Fill empty (default) / Overwrite / Add numbers policies
- New / Will update / Unchanged / Conflicts / Only on phone
  (deleting is opt-in)
- Planning runs in an isolate: 5k × 5k in about 0.5 s

Duplicates and merge
- Union-find grouping by shared number or same name, with the reason
- Choose the contact to keep; numbers, emails and notes are combined;
  Merge all goes through Review

Reach
- Call (tel:), SMS (smsto:), WhatsApp (wa.me), Signal (signal.me),
  copy number(s) as saved or international
- Asks for the default country once
- Compose with {first} {last} {name} {company} and a live preview
- One-by-one queue with Skip/Stop that persists and resumes after the
  app is killed; WhatsApp is one-by-one only
- Group SMS with the "recipients see each other" and >50 warnings
- The app never sends a message itself
- Manifest <queries> for tel, smsto, https, whatsapp and sgnl

Data
- Person schema v2 (jobTitle, phoneId, account, starred, groups),
  all optional; library_v1 is migrated in place
- New Hive boxes: journal_v1 (History), state_v1 (message queue)

Localization
- All new strings in English and Arabic, with Arabic dual and few
  plural forms

name: Release v2.0.1
body:
• Removed Google's dependency metadata from the build
• Added an Open-source licenses page and bundled the font licenses
• About now shows the correct version
• Fixed text running off narrow screens in Settings
• Batch edit and Export now follow your sort order
• "Save 1 change" instead of "Save 1 changes"

v2.0.0: fix share/save crash, add batch table editor, improve search

Fixes
- Share and Save crashed with "Illegal argument in isolate message"
  (_AsyncCompleter). Background jobs used closures that captured async
  state; they now use top-level functions with plain messages (io/jobs.dart).
  The same bug in file import and "Open with" is fixed.
- Save retries without the file-type filter on devices that reject it.
- Errors show one readable line instead of a stack dump.
- Home rows no longer overflow on narrow screens or in Arabic (RTL).

Features
- Batch editor: edit name, phone 1/2 and company in a table, highlight
  changed cells, 40-step undo, confirm before discarding, save in one
  write with an undo option.
- Operations with live before/after preview:
  names: find/replace, prefix/suffix, pattern rename ({n} {first}
  {last} {company}), change case, swap first/last, clean up names
  numbers: add/remove country code, change prefix, reformat,
  remove repeats, set label
  other: set company, add note
- New strings in English and Arabic.

Search
- The whole search pill is tappable, the clear button is bigger,
  and autocorrect is off.

Tests
- 31 tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues: operations,
  background export/import in every format, the batch editor flow,
  and full-app smoke tests in English and Arabic.

name: Contact Flow 1.0
body:
First release of Contact Flow.

Download:
- Most phones: app-arm64-v8a-release.apk
- Older 32-bit phones: app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk
- Not sure: app-release.apk (works on any device, larger file)

To install, open the APK on your phone and allow "Install unknown apps" if Android asks.
